title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 11: 49ers leave no doubt as league's elite teams emerge

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 32 things we learned in NFL Week 11: 49ers leave no doubt as league's elite teams emerge
sources.description: The NFL playoff picture is beginning to crystallize, as the Bills, Broncos and Lions each are riding six-game winning streaks. But no one is playing better than San Francisco.
